method.name: new_scene
method.description: Creates an instance of the class's scene, like [code]create[/code] in GD++ code, and returns its root. The scene is loaded once, by the first call. Returns [code]null[/code] if the scene fails to load, or if its root isn't an object of this class, so always check the result. [code]new()[/code] creates the node alone, without the scene.
